name: @justdummies/mermaid-renderer
description: Mermaid, for scripts/generate-docs.mjs only. Deliberately OUTSIDE the pnpm workspace (pnpm-workspace.yaml lists apps/site and packages/* and not this), so CI's `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` never resolves it: mermaid is 84 MB unpacked across 113 transitive packages, and the artefact it produces is committed rather than rebuilt. Install it once, by hand, where the mirror is refreshed: `npm install --prefix scripts/mermaid`.
